# On Device AI

> On Device AI is a private AI workspace for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. It runs 200+ local models and supports chat, documents, voice, listening, research, and automation. Local workflows work after the required model is downloaded; cloud providers are optional and off by default.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://ondevice-ai.app/)
- [About On Device AI](https://ondevice-ai.app/about.html)
- [Download from the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6497060890)
- [Getting started](https://ondevice-ai.app/docs/getting-started.html)
- [Documentation](https://ondevice-ai.app/docs/)

## Product facts

- [Structured brand facts](https://ondevice-ai.app/.well-known/brand-facts.json)
- [Privacy Policy](https://ondevice-ai.app/pages/privacy-policy.html)
- [Terms of Use](https://ondevice-ai.app/pages/terms-of-use.html)
- [Full product context](https://ondevice-ai.app/llms-full.txt)

On Device AI supports compatible GGUF models through llama.cpp and MLX models. It is free to download. Local workflows do not require an account; optional Pro features or third-party cloud providers may involve additional charges.
